question: Find the radius of a sphere having a surface area of 900 π cm².
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface Area = 4 × π × r²

900π = 4π × r²

r² = 900 ÷ 4 = 225

r = √225 = 15 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 15 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Surface Area of sphere = 900π cm²

Formula Used: Surface Area of sphere = 4πr²

 
 
 
• 
 
 r = ?
 Sphere Surface Area = 900π

⇒ 4 × π × r² = 900 × π

⇒ 4r² = 900

⇒ r² = 900 ÷ 4

⇒ r² = 225

⇒ r = √225

⇒ r = 15 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 15 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The volume of a sphere with radius r is given by the formula V = (4/3) × π × r³.

Surface Area of Hemisphere

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πr² and Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3πr².

Relation between Radius and Diameter

The diameter d of a sphere is twice the radius r, expressed as d = 2 × r.</p
